definitions.explanation: A relatively brief period of time, as opposed to a long-term duration. Used in business, education, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {短期|たんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{短期|たんき}⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{語学力|ごがくりょく}→語学力：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばしたい→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to improve my language skills through short-term study abroad.

examples.japanese: {短期|たんき}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to produce results in a short period.
examples.notes: 短期間 = short period of time

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {短期|たんき}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ (short period)
- {短期|たんき}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧ (junior college, two-year college - abbrev: ⟦{短大|たんだい}→短大：noentry⟧)
- {短期|たんき}⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧ (short-term study abroad)
- {短期|たんき}⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧ (short-term goal)
- {短期|たんき}⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (short-term memory)
- {短期|たんき}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (short-term contract)

ANTONYM: ⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧ (long term)

NOTE: {短期|たんき}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧ (⟦{短大|たんだい}→短大：noentry⟧) is a type of Japanese higher education institution offering 2-3 year programs.
